purpose: Give every environment family enough reusable composition variety to avoid repeated rooms, caves, forests, and aquatic backdrops while keeping pages simple to color.
selection_rule: Use only options compatible with the resolved environment profile and explicit page variant. Family variation expands choices; it never overrides the named place.
